items.html: And let us return to the matter, for behold, the Tzelem is a fine Partzuf, as mentioned, which has ten complete Sefirot. Behold, it was explained in the aforementioned discourse that after it was made from the aspect of the coupling of the upper Aba and Ima, after several aspects it was clothed in the NHY and the two-thirds of the Tifferet of the second Tevunah, which is the third, namely from the chest and below of this Tevunah, and it is the Tzadi of the Tzelem. However, you must know that the aforementioned third aspect, which is the Keter of ZA, is what is clothed in the Tifferet of the aforementioned Tevunah, as was said at the end of this discourse, with the help of God. However, the aforementioned Tzelem, which is the Partzuf of ten Sefirot of the Mochin, as mentioned — all of it is clothed in the NHY alone of the aforementioned Tevunah, which is the Tzadi of the Tzelem.
